// all five rounding directions. Generated by workorder/d48-prototype/pown_largen_phase0.py
// gen-rosetta (seed 29). Native dialect: <op> <MODE> <args> -> <result> [flags]. Flags
// (xuo): x inexact, u underflow, o overflow. Results are the correctly rounded decimal128
// value from Python decimal (exp(n·log1p(ε)) at 130 and 260 digits, which must agree), not
// from a port; an exact result takes the exponent nearest its preferred one, and a zero
// compound result the exponent ⌊|n|·min(0, Q(x))⌋ (compoundZeroResult).
// Bases: |x| − 1 from 10^-5 to 10^-34 (pown, 35% negative), x down to 10^-6176 (compound,
// the tiny rule), over/underflow edges at |z| ≈ 6,140–6,180, |ε| at 10^-5, the near-1
// family (bases a few ulps from 1; compound with n·x on the grid), and the |x| = 1 / 10,
// x = −1 rule paths at n = ±(2^31 + 1), Int64.max and Int64.min.
// `// gap:` lines are the documented 1-ulp gap (CrossPlatformArchitecture.md §12; here the
// near-1 family, in any mode), with the large-n route's answer every port must give.
// Ports with a 32-bit n exclude this file (native.exclude).
// 6619 active, 21 gap.
